Method of Attack: Dissemination via executables camouflaged as PDF documents
Phishing emails using legitimate Google Docs document sharing
Malicious payloads delivered via malspam campaigns
Injecting into svchost processes and launching multiple instances
Stealing sensitive data and banking information
Dropping other malware strains like ransomware
Using dynamic webinjects to steal PIN codes
Access-as-a-Service model providing reverse shells for lateral movement

URLs and IP addresses used in the attacks (not explicitly listed in text)
